findings.reason: the durable fix is to extend the owner (add the two trees to discovery_roots, or record why the private override must stay divergent) rather than leave placement as a one-off CLI override that a later unscoped run does not reproduce.
findings.text: §14 seeds /analysis/src/client_eqdbms.EQ32.Rev1 and /analysis/src/SAeqfame as run-scoped --root roots but leaves the facility's discovery_roots list (imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml:137, the private override of eighteen hand-picked roots it names as the cause) unchanged, so the config/graph divergence that hid these trees persists: seed_missing_roots, whose whole job is to add discovery_roots absent from the graph, will never see them and a from-scratch re-seed of jt-60sa will drop them again

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module is proposed; §21 extends one owner (imas_codex/settings.py's seat accessors) with configuration, and §14 extends one renderer (render_path_prefix_clause, imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:268) already called by the path and code claims, so behaviour is not spread across fresh wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §14 places the two trees by a run-scoped --root override rather than through the facility discovery_roots list, the owner of root placement that seed_missing_roots reconciles against.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §21 adds six model seats but names in its own text what it retires (language and vision removed from MODEL_SECTIONS, _MODEL_DEFAULTS, the environment map IMAS_CODEX_LANGUAGE_MODEL / IMAS_CODEX_VISION_MODEL, and pyproject.toml) and states why cluster-labels and ids-mapping cannot merge (so nothing outside discovery changes model), so the section accounts for its surface.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched the codebase it names and cites the mechanisms it extends: the sn-* per-function seat pattern (settings.MODEL_SECTIONS / _MODEL_DEFAULTS / _MODEL_ENV_VARS and register_model_endpoints) for §21, and seed_facility_roots plus render_path_prefix_clause for §14; §21's third node accurately diagnoses an existing gap (the synchronous call_llm_structured lacks the local-endpoint branch that acall_llm_structured has at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:2376), verified against the code.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no forwarding layer is added; §21 makes the seat a required argument on the health-check, monitor and DiscoveryConfig entry points rather than keeping a default that shims to a vanished seat, and the third node routes the synchronous local branch through the existing _get_local_client helper instead of a second implementation.
